hrPlatform.title: HR Process Management System
hrPlatform.description: An Angular application for handling HR processes in companies.
highlights: Designed and implemented a dynamic component rendering engine that generates UI views from backend configuration, reducing development time for new HR workflows.
Built a configurable dynamic forms module using Formly with custom field types, validation rules, and event-driven actions, enabling non-developers to define HR processes.
Contributed to a multi-step request approval workflow handling end-to-end submission, review, and resolution of HR requests.
Implemented a TimeCard module for project-based time tracking with reporting capabilities.
Ensured WCAG AA accessibility compliance and full internationalization support using ngx-translate.

nfcConfigTool.title: NFC Card Configuration Tool
nfcConfigTool.description: A Progressive Web App for reading and configuring NFC-enabled cards over the USB Web API.
highlights: Developed a Progressive Web Application for reading and configuring NFC-enabled cards via the USB Web API.
Implemented multi-version firmware support to ensure backward compatibility across different card hardware.
Built real-time data visualization dashboards using Chart.js for device diagnostics.

streamingVodPlatform.title: Streaming/VOD Platform
streamingVodPlatform.description: A cross-platform streaming and video-on-demand application for Android Mobile, iOS, Android TV, and Tizen (Samsung Smart TV).
highlights: Maintained and improved a cross-platform streaming and video-on-demand application targeting Android Mobile, iOS, Android TV, and Tizen (Samsung Smart TV).
Resolved playback issues and optimized the Video.js player with adaptive bitrate streaming across platform-specific environments.
Implemented multi-language support.

imageInvestmentPlatform.title: Token-Based Image Investment Platform
imageInvestmentPlatform.description: A Next.js investment platform enabling token-based image trading with wallet integration.
highlights: Built an investment platform enabling token-based image trading with wallet integration via RainbowKit.
Implemented a high-resolution image gallery viewer using OpenSeadragon with zoom and pan capabilities.
Integrated AWS Amplify Gen2 for authentication, API, and serverless backend infrastructure.

pulsar.title: Pulsar
pulsar.description: A full-stack social platform for publishing posts and comments, built with Angular 20 and NgRx Signal Store.
highlights: Built a full-stack social platform for publishing posts and comments with paginated feeds.
Implemented role-based access control with an admin panel for user management and moderation.
Added light/dark theme switching and multi-language support using ngx-translate.
Wrote unit tests using Karma and Jasmine to ensure component reliability and prevent regressions.
Implemented a user moderation system with permanent bans, time-based bans, and shadow bans for content visibility control.

portfolio.title: Portfolio Website
portfolio.description: This portfolio website, built to showcase my experience, skills, and projects with a bilingual, theme-aware interface.
highlights: Built with Next.js App Router and TypeScript for a fast, statically-optimized site.
Implemented multi-language support (English/Polish) using next-intl with locale-aware routing.
Added light/dark theme switching using next-themes.
Styled with Tailwind CSS for a fully responsive, accessible layout.
